import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

def clean(df):
    df = df.copy()
    # Convert body_mass_g from text (with commas/spaces) to numeric grams
    mass_str = df["body_mass_g"].astype(str).str.replace(r"[,\s]", "", regex=True)
    df["body_mass_g"] = pd.to_numeric(mass_str, errors="coerce")
    # Enforce valid body mass range from the rules
    df.loc[(df["body_mass_g"] < 2500) | (df["body_mass_g"] > 6500), "body_mass_g"] = np.nan
    # Keep only rows that can contribute to the per-species total
    df = df.dropna(subset=["species", "body_mass_g"])
    return df

def answer(df):
    cleaned = clean(df)
    totals = cleaned.groupby("species", dropna=True)["body_mass_g"].sum()
    return {str(species): float(mass) for species, mass in totals.items()}
